items.q: Can we see real documents before we order?
items.a: Yes, redacted: index, protocol contents and record formats from a delivered system, shared [openly or under NDA]. Your QA team can also audit how records are produced.

items.q: When do we see the protocols?
items.a: The FAT protocol reaches your quality unit [protocol issue before FAT, weeks] before testing, for approval. IQ and OQ protocols follow, referencing FAT results rather than repeating them.

items.q: Can FAT results count towards qualification?
items.a: Where your quality unit agrees, yes (Annex 15, 3.6). We mark candidate test cases in the C&Q plan at detailed design. Water quality on your feed is never leveraged.

items.q: Do you check third-party certificates, or just forward them?
items.a: We check them: markings against the certificate at receipt, [PMI, standard or option]. Certificates reach you as the issuer sent them, never retyped.
